result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Answer A's labels, values and title are pale text on a white background, so they are nearly unreadable. Its heavy dark bar tracks and row borders also crowd the bars, and its footnote wrongly adds the per-site species counts into a total of 301, although the same species can appear at several sites. Answer B is clean and legible: it uses one calm color, the bars are sorted from highest to lowest, and every bar has its value next to it. Its only real weakness is a title that names the topic but says nothing about the pattern. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Answer A is a clean, readable sorted bar chart that starts at zero, uses one calm green and puts each site's label and count next to its bar. Its title only names the topic and doesn't point out a pattern. Answer B has a better headline, but most of its text is pale on a white background and nearly unreadable, the heavy dark bar tracks and dividing rules add clutter, and its footnote wrongly adds species counts across sites to get 301, which double-counts species seen at more than one site.
